title: NINTENDO GAMEBOY MUG • Heat Change Coffee Cup With Box 4" Tall White Paladone
descriptionText:
This Nintendo Gameboy mug is the perfect addition to any retro gaming collection. The ceramic and porcelain material with a white Paladone finish makes it a durable and stylish choice for enjoying hot beverages. The mug is 4 inches wide and comes with a coffee cup set that is perfect for coffee or tea.

The round shape and color-changing glass type add to the unique design of this mug. It features heat-changing capabilities, making it a great choice for hot drinks. This original and licensed reproduction mug is a must-have for any Nintendo fan.
